works.title: Friendship, Wisconsin
works.description: A contemporary novel set in the user's rural Central Wisconsin hometown, conceived as a modern update to Steinbeck's The Grapes of Wrath. The narrative follows a man returning to a hollowed-out town after personal devastation, paralleling his healing with efforts to revive the community. Explores themes of economic extraction, precarity, rural decline, class consciousness, and the emergence of left-wing political movements in struggling regions.
works.quote: I want to discuss an idea for another book that touches on these related themes and dives more deeply into precarity. I grew up in a rural Central Wisconsin farm community named Friendship—literally the name of the town.

works.title: Article on Entitlement and Spiritual Growth
works.description: An article or series of articles exploring how entitlement undermines gratitude, compassion, and spiritual growth. The user frames entitlement as an emotional sense that blocks genuine connection and inner development, examining its spiritual and psychological costs. Very early-stage development focused on thematic exploration through headline generation and definition work.
works.quote: 10 Headlines for an Article on How Entitlement Undermines Gratitude, Compassion, and Spiritual Growth
